_comment: Ground-truth Roman-numeral corpus for eval/run_rn_eval.py (A7). Source: music21's bundled bach/choraleAnalyses/*.rntxt (Riemenschneider-numbered hand analyses by Andrew Jones et al., proofread by Dmitri Tymoczko and Hamish Robb). Ships with music21 itself, already a dependency, so unlike the Humdrum/KernScores corpus flagged in docs/research/15-tier3-remainder.md, no external licensing clearance is needed. Only chorales whose BWV number also resolves to a music21 corpus MusicXML score are included (2 of the 20 bundled rntxt files -- BWV 248(2).12 and 41.6s -- don't resolve to a plain bach/bwvN.M corpus path and are left out).
